content:
In addition to Amazon's ongoing early fall Prime Day sale and today's massive $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, today's 9to5Toys midday deal headline is the iPhone 17 Pro Max across all models priced up to $513 below the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium). We also have ecobee's official early fall Prime Day HomeKit deals going live today, with up to $210 off the Smart Thermostat and bundles, plus discounts on a range of Apple accessories: Solo Loop bands for as low as $7, a rare $100 off the Apple Magic Keyboard Folio, and the official MagSafe Battery Pack at 40% off. There are also plenty of chargers, TVs, smart speakers, and more deals waiting for you below.

Amazon is currently offering the iPhone 17 Pro Max across all models, priced up to $513 below the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium)

We've seized the opportunity multiple times before to grab iPhone 17 Pro deals directly from Amazon, but with the early fall Prime Day now live, we're seeing significant discounts on unlocked Renewed Premium models for the first time. Although the iPhone 18 Pro Max has already launched, you can now get the similarly specced 17 Pro for over $500 less. Details below.

1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max now starts from as low as $1,385.78 with free shipping. That's $213 below the original retail price for this model, and a whopping $513 less than Apple's price for the 1TB 18 Pro Max.

Samsung launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max this month at $1,899; while the 1TB 17 Pro Max didn't debut at that high a price, market rates have risen, and now you can get a solid discount through Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed listing.

Only the Deep Blue model is priced this low directly from Amazon; other models are still well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max's price:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (originally $1,599)

Apple still doesn't sell the iPhone 17 series in its official refurbished store; what we're looking at here is the highest quality refurbished unit sold by Amazon, backed by a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee, with battery life "above 90% of original capacity" — definitely not your average refurb.

Here are the latest pricing details for Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro units:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange: $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver: $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange: $1,179 (new original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver: $1,179 (new original price $1,299)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off at Amazon, available in Silver and Space Black

The latest M5 MacBook Air still has some decent deals, but we want to circle back to Amazon's massive $500 discount on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro — both the Space Black and Silver models have now dropped to this deep discount.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,699 with free shipping, equipped with 24GB RAM and 2TB of storage.

This price matches the lowest we've tracked in recent months, but now both Space Black and Silver versions are in stock — Silver doesn't typically see discounts as often as Black.

Apple Solo Loop clearance sale is live: one for $7, two for $10, three for $15 (originally from $49)

Kicking off the early fall Prime Day deals, Woot has just launched a clearance sale on official Apple Braided Solo Loop and Apple Watch Solo Loop bands. Each band is slashed to just $6.99 with Prime shipping, and buying "two or more" gets you an additional 30% off at checkout.

We've seen plenty of Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but never at prices this low. We expect colors and sizes to start selling out fast — at prices like these, if there's a style you want, place your order quickly.

The Solo Loop retails for $49, so even buying just one is already an incredible deal. But buying two or more gets you an additional 30% off, making it an absolute steal:

  • Apple Solo Loop: $7 (originally from $49)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop: $10 (originally from $98)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop: $15 (originally from $147)

Colors and sizes are already starting to sell out, so we'll say it again — hurry and grab them while supplies last.

Rare $100 discount! Apple iPad Magic Keyboard Folio slashed at Amazon

ecobee's official early fall Prime Day HomeKit deals go live today: Smart Thermostat, bundles, and more discounted up to $210

Even though we're still in early fall Prime Day mode with thousands of discounts to choose from, ecobee has informed 9to5Toys that their official Prime Big Deal Days promotion actually starts today. From now through October 7, you can find deals spanning their popular HomeKit Smart Thermostat product line, as well as bundle sets discounted over $200.

ecobee's official early fall Prime Day deals go live today

Although these deals' product listings don't yet carry official Prime Day tags, the pricing already reflects ecobee's official early fall Prime Day discounts, with many matching the deals we tracked during the summer Prime Day sale. Outside of major seasonal sales events, it's hard to find this brand's products at such deep discounts with such comprehensive selection, so if you're looking to upgrade your smart home, don't miss this opportunity — act fast.

  • Smart Thermostat Premium: $210 (originally $260)

  • Smart Doorbell Camera: $120 (originally $160)

Full bundle discounts:

Essentially all full bundle pricing matches — or is even lower than — what we tracked during the official summer Prime Day event.

This deep launch deal joins the early fall Prime Day discounts on the Fire TV Stick and streaming device lineup, starting from $16.

Fire TV Stick early fall Prime Day deals:

Amazon just unveiled a massive wave of upcoming early fall Prime Day deals

Brand-new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals return to Amazon (up to $50 off)

Alongside this morning's two rounds of $500 discounts on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, Amazon has also resumed launch deals on all new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio units.

The 2026 Mac mini equipped with the brand-new M6 chip, as well as the higher-end M5 Pro models they carry, have all fallen back to their lowest historical prices:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB: $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB: $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB: $1,270 (originally $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB: $1,669 (originally $1,699)

The brand-new Mac Studio equipped with 36GB RAM and 512GB built-in storage also has $50 off:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB: $2,449 (originally $2,499)

While these aren't exactly huge discounts, for those looking to upgrade right after a product launches, Amazon is now offering the lowest prices — every available configuration has hit a historical low. We want to make sure you catch these deals as the new work week begins.
